subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: The Panama Papers
description: A quick, practical guide to The Panama Papers.

hook.text: 11.5 million documents leaked from a law firm, exposing how the world's richest people hide their money.

buildup.text: Mossack Fonseca helped politicians, celebrities, and criminals create anonymous shell companies.

discovery.text: The papers revealed secret holdings of 12 world leaders, including Iceland's prime minister.

twist.text: Iceland's PM resigned within days. But most of the powerful people named faced no consequences at all.

climax.text: The largest leak in history exposed global financial secrecy — and showed how rarely the rich pay a price.

punchline.text: Secrets of the powerful, exposed. Little changed.

quiz.question: What did the Panama Papers reveal?
options: How wealthy individuals used shell companies to hide money
